description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-15. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Android Auto playlists:** Stream-downloaded playlists and albums now appear in **Playlists**. Each card
  opens **Play all** and its songs; start the playlist from any available song. **Downloaded songs** groups
  loose stream copies. Offline, the last complete catalog stays visible, with uncached playlists marked
  **Unavailable offline** and partially downloaded lists identified. **Downloaded playlists** now contains
  device-file playlists only. Also fixes playlist pages incorrectly showing Songs unavailable.
- **Offline queue recovery:** When the connection drops during an online-started queue, cached songs play
  immediately from their local copies, including requests already loading. Uncached songs are skipped on
  Next or automatic advancement. If this recovery stops the queue, Play restarts the previous cached song
  from the beginning. Works on the phone and Android Auto; online lyrics, radio and queue updates stay intact.
- **Glass miniplayer and navigation bar (#47):** Separate glass styles with live previews and controls for
  blur, tint, size and opacity, plus optional spinning artwork. Both are off by default. Enable them under
  **RVX settings > Player** and **RVX settings > Navigation bar**. Requires Music 8.51 or newer; background
  blur requires Android 14 or newer. Summaries align with other settings, and playlist/Liked Music Play
  buttons stay above either glass style or both together.
- **Settings shortcut (#51):** Optional toolbar gear beside the profile icon. Tap for Music settings;
  touch and hold for RVX settings. Enable it under **RVX settings > General**; off by default.
- **Miniplayer dismissal (#49):** Swiping the miniplayer away stops retained crossfade playback. Home and
  normal background playback are unchanged.
- **Older versions and lyrics:** Fix Music 8.30 download-button patching and restore Scrobbling/playlist tap
  actions on 6.20, with warnings for unsupported hooks instead of patch failures. Recognize local timed LRC
  lyrics, fix account headers and retry transient lyrics failures. Apply the dark palette to offline dialogs.

## YouTube

- **Yellow repeat (#48):** Rewind and pause when the video ends; Play resumes the same video. Blue repeat
  and repeat-off autoplay stay unchanged.
- **Shorts panels (#50):** Repeat the current Short while comments or another engagement panel is open,
  keeping the controls in place. Normal autoplay resumes when the panel closes.
- **On-the-go (#53):** Fix hiding its entry in the player settings menu.
- **Other fixes:** Preserve imported feed-playback settings, Home filters and category-bar choices. Fix
  newer shelf/Ask-button hiding, title-subtitle taps, Music-app links on older Android and third-party clients,
  live-quality buffer retention, engagement panels, end-of-video scrolling and notifications without artwork.

## Both apps

- **Profile handles (#46):** Visible by default, with Hide handle still optional and its switch restored
  on newer Music. Existing saved choices are kept.
- **Stream spoofing:** Add missing/outdated WebView warnings with repair links, improve visionOS retry
  handling and avoid premature OAuth connection-error notices during startup.
- **Experimental targets (#52):** Optional support for **YouTube 21.45.90** and **Music 9.45.51**, including
  Music's Downloads chip and offline queue recovery. These targets are experimental; recommended defaults
  remain **YouTube 21.39.525** and **Music 9.40.51**. Existing supported versions remain available.
- **Bug reports:** Rename URV Manager to UP Manager in the issue-template tool list.
